# West Medical

> West Medical is a Los Angeles-based surgical center specializing in minimally-invasive bariatric weight loss surgery and advanced vein treatments with personalized patient support.

West Medical serves patients across Southern California with expertise in gastric bypass, gastric sleeve, and revision bariatric procedures, alongside comprehensive varicose vein and spider vein treatments. The practice emphasizes advanced technology, including robot-assisted daVinci X surgical systems, and provides extensive before-and-after patient results.
